caption: The drawing depicts three views of a decorative, metal, cube-shaped stove or heater with intricate designs. The object is mostly brown with hints of red and gold. The main perspective shows the object in three dimensions with ornate openwork sides featuring swirling, symmetrical patterns and circular motifs. One face has a central circle surrounded by radial elements, possibly forming a vent or decorative grille. Another side displays a rectangular plaque with additional detail. The top-down view, placed above the main image, shows the square top surface adorned with concentric raised circles and several circular openings arranged around a central enhancer, possibly a handle or decorative element. The front view, to the right, further illustrates the intricate cutouts and patterns, as well as a prominent circular design in the center. The objects are set against a plain, cream-colored background, and the artist's signature "W.O. Fletcher" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Safe Bank
